description: Stop an Intercom announcement that is still repeating (POST /v1/hubs/{hub_id}/intercom/announcements/{id}/cancel): the API tells the hub, which stops repeating at once. Only an announcement whose status is sending can be cancelled (any other is refused as not_cancellable). The answer is the announcement with status cancelled and hub_confirmed: false means the hub could not confirm the stop, so it may still repeat until it is reachable or someone says they heard it: tell the people in the home, and the hub's Intercom switch also stops it. Cancelling only ever stops speech and is safe to repeat. It does not need THALOVANT_ENABLE_INTERCOM_ANNOUNCE and is left out in read-only mode. Requires the intercom:send scope.

announcementId.description: The id of the announcement to stop (thalovant_intercom_announce returned it).

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_intercom_cancel_announcement
title: Cancel Intercom Announcement
